next.reason: 1985: "all CODE-SET clauses in the run unit which are associated with that file connector must have the same character set"; 2023: "If any of the file description entries has a CODE-SET clause, all shall have a CODE-SET clause specifying the same character set.". 1985 constrains only the CODE-SET clauses present. 2023 also requires every entry for the external connector to have CODE-SET once any has one, so mixing entries with and without it is refused.
